svg.text: Industry structure emerges in B without any industry label
Columns of the cross-layer weight matrix B, averaged into industry x industry blocks.
Each column is one Taiwanese stock's loading on the 30 US stocks.
Mean cosine similarity between columns of B
Positive in 10/10 seeds. Permutation test (industry labels shuffled 1000x): p <= 0.001.
The diagonal is uniformly warm (+0.20 to +0.58); off-diagonal cells are near zero.
Industries with n >= 2 shown (9 of 18). Cell = mean cosine over all cross-pairs of the two industries; diagonal = within-industry mean.
